verdict.rationale: Relevance tuning is a fair axis for a search engine, but the pack does not show Elasticsearch boosting results by business signals such as popularity, recency or margin, nor custom scoring rules. It only covers hybrid full-text plus vector retrieval merged with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), which still ranks on content matching, and structured filters, which narrow results rather than re-rank them. Off-topic community items on licensing, pricing and AWS were ignored.
